entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I bought some shoes a while ago, and I think I need to send them back. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I'm not really sure what you'd call it. They're your special **cycling shoes**. I tried to attach the **cleats**, but the instructions were really hard to follow. When I finally wore them on a ride, they gave me terrible **blisters**.
I'm very sorry to hear about that discomfort. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order information.
I looked on the website and it said something about 10 days, then 20 days... I got so overwhelmed, I don't understand it at all. Can't you just help me?
Of course. There's no need to worry. I can see here you received the order 48 days ago. For standard items like these **cycling shoes**, our policy allows for returns within 10 days.
Yes, absolutely. You're well within the return window, so I can go ahead and authorize this return for a full **refund** for you right now.
Oh, wow. That's such a relief. Thank you so much. I was so worried I was stuck with them.

Not a problem at all. I've just emailed you a pre-paid return label. Please pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any post office. Your refund will be issued once our warehouse receives the item.
Okay, that sounds simple enough. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
